localized_network_results.geometry_conclusion: Using rawR as the full physical round-trip propagation coordinate while retaining the declared L requires c=2Lfs/R, not the baseline c=2Lfs/P. At fixed mass this changes tension by (P/R)^2. Keeping baseline c instead shortens the represented physical L by R/P. A localized bank therefore offers a coherent alternate network, not the already-declared distributed stiff-string model.
localized_network_results.boundary_conclusion: Fixed termination -F with fixed nut reflection -1 folds to a positive loop F. If F is stable and Schur it is a passive boundary; an allpass component represents reactive termination phase, not distributed propagation. The selected actual banks have stable poles and dense-grid magnitudes below one; that is a diagnostic, not a proof over every control state.
localized_network_results.source_force_limit: u is an arbitrary additive displacement-wave source waveform. Neither algebraic equivalence nor equal-ray symmetry validates the current Bessel source as a calibrated point force; physical displacement-source amplitude is related to the time integral of external force through the two-sided wave impedance.
